in_sanskrit.name: संपदा
in_sanskrit.meaning: complete, full, wealth, prosperity, and abundance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has all the desired things in life, both material and spiritual, and is content and satisfied.

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has all the desired things in life, both material and spiritual, and is content and satisfied.

in_marathi.name: Sampada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sampada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A vessel or container filled with wealth, prosperity, and abundance. This name is given to a girl born into a prosperous family or expected to bring prosperity to her family.
